recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key studio portrait of a woman leaning over a vintage mantel clock, set against a deep black background. The lighting is soft and directional, highlighting her face, hands, and a single pink rose resting on the clock. The composition is anchored by the circular clock face at the bottom center, with the subject framing it symmetrically.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's arms framing the central clock prop
High contrast between the dark background and the bright clock face
Textual elements clustered in the upper-left quadrant for balance
Warm skin tones and gold accents against a cool black void
coreInvariants: Circular clock face as a central anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame, leaning forward toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white circular clock face at the bottom center acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright clock face, moves up the subject's arms to her face, and then to the typography in the top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subject, particularly in the upper right and top edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and cream (clock face and teeth)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty rose (flower and title text) and gold (jewelry and clock trim)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast on the clock face and skin highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight letter spacing with overlapping characters
Exaggerated ball terminals and teardrop swashes
Thick vertical strokes with thin, curved connectors
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature deep, curling swashes that tuck under adjacent letters
Ascenders and descenders are shortened to allow for tight vertical stacking

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking two weights or colors of the same swash family for title and artist name.
graphicDevices: Thin gold filigree underline/flourish below the text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s-era heavy serif look with ornate terminals.
Provides the correct period-accurate high-contrast serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with a 60s bouffant hairstyle, wearing a black sleeveless dress and a pearl necklace, leaning her chin on her hands over a vintage round mantel clock. A single pink rose sits on top of the clock. Deep black background, soft warm lighting on the face and clock.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top-left corner using a heavy swash serif font. The top line should be dusty rose and the bottom line white. Include a thin gold decorative swirl flourish underneath the text.

verificationChecks: Is the clock face the brightest point in the lower half?
Does the text feature overlapping swash characters?
Is the background a solid, deep black?
Is the lighting soft and directional?

adjustableVariables: Color of the rose and matching text
Specific time shown on the clock face
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the tight kerning.
Check that the rose looks naturally placed on the clock.
Verify the skin tones are warm and not washed out by the clock's brightness.
Confirm the black background is free of digital noise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + central circular prop + top-left stacked swash typography + low-key lighting.
